title: 19.11 A 13GHz Charge-Pump PLL Achieving 15.8fsrms Integrated Jitter and -98.5dBc Reference Spur
problem: Modern RF-sampling communication systems (wideband data converters, complex modulation) impose stringent phase-locked loop (PLL) requirements: ultra-low jitter and near-zero reference spurs. Sub-sampling PLLs achieve superior low-frequency phase noise but suffer large reference spurs from BFSK effects. Sampling PLLs avoid periodic VCO modulation but are limited by available loop gain (K_stope). Charge-pump PLLs dominate industry but their in-band phase noise, set by charge-pump characteristics, makes ultra-low jitter challenging.
motivation: RF-sampling systems require ultra-pure clock signals for spectral efficiency in wideband data converters; phase noise and reference spurs directly degrade signal quality and modulation performance.
method: This charge-pump phase-locked loop (a circuit using controlled currents to synchronize an oscillator to a reference clock) uses a dual-path design combining three refinements: a resistive-discharge phase detector that improves linearity (eliminating distortion) and provides higher gain, a series-resonance oscillator with tuned LC circuitry and overvoltage protection that suppresses jitter (timing noise), and a sampling-based filter providing sharp filtering without large capacitors. The dual-path architecture—using two parallel signal paths working together—allows the high-gain phase detector to suppress timing noise while maintaining stable lock.
key_novelty: A dual-path charge-pump phase-locked loop architecture combining a resistive-discharge phase detector and series-resonance oscillator achieves 15.8 femtoseconds of integrated jitter and -98.5dBc reference spur at 13GHz.
contributions: Reference spur suppression: -98.5dBc (near ideal, SSPPLL-matching performance)
Resistive-discharge TAPFD improving charge-pump phase noise characteristics
Series-resonance VCO achieving sub-fs jitter contribution with over-voltage protection

metrics.other: Integrated jitter: 15.8fsrms, Reference spur: -98.5dBc, Center freq: 13GHz

primary_theme: Dual-path charge-pump PLL with ultra-low jitter and spur suppression
